chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems/ /sprul sku dpal chen he ru ka dpal che/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang shāka thub dga' rab la/ /sman mchod 'bul la

tei:div.tei:p: chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems// sprul sku dpal chen he ru ka dpal che// rdo rje 'chang dbang shāka thub dga' rab la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// rdo rje chos dang las kyi dbang mo che// ind+ra bhū ti shrī sing ha dang*// go ma sa dang slob dpon hūm̐ mdzad la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// pra bha hasti padmāka ra rje// ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong lde 'u btsan// rgyal sras chos blo klu yi dbang po la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// shud bu dpal seng dri med zla shar zhabs// zab gter sgo 'byed mchog gyur bde chen gling*// bka' bab brgyud 'dzin slob mar bcas pa la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum// sras mchog khro bcu za gsod sgo ma dang*// shwa na re ti bswe mo ging chen bzhir// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// phyi 'khor skyong ba dbang phyug brtan ma dang*// dregs pa sde brgyad 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha// yul ris gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor tshogs la// sman mchod 'bul lo phrin las kun 'grub mdzod//
ces pa'ang rtogs ldan gyis bskul ngor zla ming pas bris//
